title: 夜色闪光灯下的韩系纯欲自拍
prompt_en: Create A Close-up selfie of a beautiful young woman. Skin: Porcelain white, bright, smooth, and poreless. Face: Symmetrical; do not change the original face. Style: Edgy and mysterious. Pose: Standing in a room (likely a living room). Head tilted down, looking towards the camera. Calm expression with lips slightly parted, biting the index finger. Camera Angle: Low angle selfie. Outfit & Accessories: Outfit: reference photo 2. Accessories: Small thin necklace with a rose pendant; medium-sized hoop earrings. Nails: Light brown with white tips (French tip style). Makeup (Detailed Korean Ulzzang Style): Skin Finish: Super smooth glass skin, milky bright tone, thin dewy glowing foundation. Highlighting: Soft highlights on the forehead, nose, and chin. Eyebrows: Straight,tebal natural, soft,. Eye Makeup: Soft pink-peach gradient with subtle shimmer; very thin "puppy" eyeliner; long, curly, naturally separated eyelashes. Under-eye: Clear and glowing "aegyo sal" with small highlights; brightened under-eye area. Blush: Baby pink "over-blush" spreading across the cheeks and bridge of the nose. Nose & Lips: Small slim nose with soft contour; "cherry pink" glossy jelly lips with a gradient (darker on the inside); well-defined cupid's bow. Expression: Innocent, cute, and youthful. Hair: Length & Color: Very long, dark brown hair. Texture: Smooth and shiny. Style: Straight on top, wavy/curly at the bottom. Bangs: curtain bangs,dan helaian rambut menutupi wajahnya,slightly messy on top. Bagian atasnya sedikit berantakan Environment & Quality: Background: Dark indoor setting, showing a blurred door and sofa. Atmosphere: Nighttime. Lighting: Direct flash focusing on the subject, especially the face, creating a bright and glowing effect. Technical Quality: HD, 8k high resolution. Aspect Ratio: 9:16. Don't change face
